literal: Daozong, Part Four
idiomatic: Daozong, Part Four

literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on renshen day, went to the Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on renshen day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

literal: On guiyou day granted chancellor Yelü Xiaojie the name Renjie.
idiomatic: On guiyou day chancellor Yelü Xiaojie was granted the name Renjie.

literal: On yihai day went to Shanyu Marsh.
idiomatic: On yihai day the court went to Shanyu Marsh.

literal: Third month, on xinwei day, because Chancellor Renjie obtained a swan's head, he was promoted Palace Attendant.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the third month, because Chancellor Renjie obtained a swan's head, he was promoted Palace Attendant.

literal: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Li, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
idiomatic: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Li, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiwei day, went to Nage Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the fourth summer month the court went to Nage Marsh.

literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the fifth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yange Southern Court chancellor; Northern linya Yelü Yongning yilibi; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Tabuye and Palace Front deputy commander and imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo were all enfeoffed Prince of Lanling Commandery.
idiomatic: Khitan mobile palace deployment director Yelü Yange was made Southern Court chancellor; Northern linya Yelü Yongning was made yilibi; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Tabuye and Palace Front deputy commander and imperial son-in-law Xiao Chouwo were all enfeoffed Prince of Lanling Commandery.

literal: Sixth month, on xinhai day, Zubu came with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the sixth month Zubu came with tribute.

literal: On dingsi day Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Northern Court chancellor and Prince of Liaoxi Xiao Yuliye was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

literal: On jiwei day dispatched envoys to review prisoners.
idiomatic: On jiwei day envoys were dispatched to review prisoners.

literal: That month the jinshi Liu Jin and one hundred thirteen others were passed.
idiomatic: That month the jinshi Liu Jin and one hundred thirteen others were passed.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao day, hunted at Jia Mountain.
idiomatic: On jimao day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Jia Mountain.

literal: Eighth month, on gengshen day, ordered the relevant offices to compose the 《Stele of Taizong's Divine Merit》 and erect it at Nanjing.
idiomatic: On gengshen day of the eighth month the relevant offices were ordered to compose the 《Stele of Taizong's Divine Merit》 and erect it at Nanjing.

literal: Ninth month, on jimao day, edict ordered all routes not to forbid monks from opening altars.
idiomatic: On jimao day of the ninth month an edict ordered all routes not to forbid monks from opening altars.

literal: On renwu day forbidden escorts to harass the people.
idiomatic: On renwu day escorts were forbidden to harass the people.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuxu day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the tenth winter month Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jihai day halted at Dulujin.
idiomatic: On jihai day the court halted at Dulujin.

literal: On renzi day, edict ordered that only imperial sons might remain single-character princes; the rest were all demoted.
idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered that only imperial sons might remain single-character princes; the rest were all demoted.

literal: On dingsi day relieved poor people in Ping Prefecture.
idiomatic: On dingsi day poor people in Ping Prefecture were relieved.

literal: Eleventh month, on dingchou day summoned monk Shoudao to open an altar in the inner hall.
idiomatic: On dingchou day of the eleventh month monk Shoudao was summoned to open an altar in the inner hall.

literal: On guimao day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.
idiomatic: On guimao day Nanjing refugees' corvée was remitted for three years; households that had suffered fire were exempt from rent and tax for one year.

literal: Twelfth month, on bingwu day a comet violated the Tail constellation.

literal: On yimao day visited the Western Capital.
idiomatic: On yimao day the court visited the Western Capital.

literal: On wuwu day performed the rebirth ritual; amnesty for mixed offenses from capital crime downward.

literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on guiyou day, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guiyou day of the first spring month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao day, hunted at Tanshan.

idiomatic: On renshen day of the fifth month one year's rent and tax for Ping Prefecture households resuming cultivation was remitted.

literal: On gengyin day, because of drought, prayed for rain; ordered attendants to douse one another with water, and soon rain fell.
idiomatic: On gengyin day, because of drought, rain was prayed for; attendants were ordered to douse one another with water, and soon rain fell.

literal: Sixth month, on wuxu day, halted at Nage Marsh.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the sixth month the court halted at Nage Marsh.

literal: On wushen day Revenue Commissioner Wang Ji Associate Administrator of Affairs.

literal: On gengxu day Jurchen dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On gengxu day Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day viewed the market.
idiomatic: On wuchen day of the seventh autumn month the court viewed the market.

literal: On jiyou day halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiyou day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
